proof_body:
by
  intro A _ I hn x hx
  rw [← Ideal.jacobson_bot, Ideal.mem_jacobson_iff]
  intro y
  have hu : IsUnit (1 + y * x) := (hn _ (I.mul_mem_left y hx)).isUnit_one_add
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hu
  refine ⟨↑u⁻¹, ?_⟩
  have h1 : (↑u⁻¹ : A) * (1 + y * x) = 1 := by rw [← hu]; simp
  rw [Ideal.mem_bot, mul_assoc]
  rw [mul_add, mul_one] at h1
  rw [add_comm, h1, sub_self]
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [Ring A] (I : Ideal A), (∀ x ∈ I, IsNilpotent x) → I ≤ Ring.jacobson A
